scenes.say: Verstappen won Vegas from pole. Behind him, pure chaos.
Norris second, Piastri third, after starting seventeenth.
Lap thirty-eight: Leclerc hits his teammate and Hamilton spins. Ten seconds for Leclerc.
After the safety car, Hadjar's front wing broke. He finished fourteenth.
Three laps from the end Russell was third. A lock-up, the barrier, and ninth place.
On the last lap Antonelli ran out of energy, and both McLarens went past.
Both Aston Martins reached the flag. This season, that's rare.
Verstappen tightened his grip on second in the championship.
Qatar is next. Check the race start in your own time zone on LapRadar.

title: Las Vegas race: Verstappen wins from pole, Ferraris collide, Russell hits the wall
